model_annotation: The bar chart, titled "每日新增患者人数与新闻媒体报道数目变化趋势" (Daily New Patient Numbers and News Media Report Count Trend), illustrates the relationship between the number of new confirmed cases and the number of news media reports related to COVID-19 in China from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022. The horizontal axis represents the date, with data points shown at regular intervals. The left vertical axis, labeled "每日新增患者人数" (Daily New Patient Numbers), ranges from 0 to 1,800,000, while the right vertical axis, labeled "新闻媒体每日报道数目" (Daily News Media Report Count), ranges from 0 to 6,000. The chart uses two data series: green vertical bars represent the "该日全球确诊数量" (Global Confirmed Cases on that day), and a blue line represents the "有关covid-19新闻数量" (Number of COVID-19 News Reports). The green bars show a fluctuating trend in daily new cases, with a peak around July 15, 2022, reaching approximately 1,600,000, and a subsequent decline. The blue line, representing news reports, also fluctuates, with a peak around the same time, reaching about 5,000 reports per day. The data indicates that both the number of new cases and the volume of news coverage generally decreased after mid-July, with the number of news reports consistently remaining below 5,000 per day for the remainder of the period.
